content:
emma_cs: Customer reported promo code rejected as 'invalid or expired' when redeeming during signup. They say the same code shows active in Dashboard and worked for another teammate earlier today. User email: lucy@example.com. Attached screenshot and logs.
raj_engineer: thanks — can you paste the exact code and whether they used the web flow or the API? also any trace ids from the error screen? :eyes:
emma_cs: Code is AcT12-NEWBIE (user pasted). They used the web signup flow (chrome mobile). Error message: \"promo_code.invalid_or_expired\". No trace id in UI. Screenshot: shows form error under coupon field. Reports dashboard preview shows code active until 2026-12-31.
mike_ops: adding platform logs now. @raj_engineer I see a 400 on /v1/promos/redeem around the same minute, request id r-0a12b3c4. Full request body (sanitized): ```{\n  "email": "lucy@example.com",\n  "code": "AcT12-NEWBIE",\n  "source": "web_signup"\n}```
raj_engineer: thanks. Can you paste the response body and the backend auth header? also whether web frontend does any normalization on the code (strip/uppercase)?
mike_ops: response: ```{\n  "error": "Invalid or expired coupon",\n  "code": "promo_code.invalid_or_expired"\n}```
Also saw this in promo-service logs: ```promo_lookup failed for key: act12-newbie; db_lookup=null; matched_case_sensitive=false```
raj_engineer: interesting — logs show we were looking up the lowercased key (act12-newbie) but the DB has codes stored as mixed case. We recently deployed a migration that canonicalizes codes to UPPERCASE in the database but the lookup layer still sometimes sends LOWERCASE when requests come from older routing. looks like a mismatch window.
sophie_billing: timeline: migration ran last night to normalize historical promos to uppercase to standardize signing. Some routing pods were drained after that but one older replica (pre-migration image) remained and served a small fraction of requests with old normalization behaviour.
emma_cs: ok — can we confirm this caused Lucy's failure and what's the user-facing fix? she needs the credit now.
raj_engineer: reproducible locally: calling redeem with exact code \"AcT12-NEWBIE\" against post-migration DB returns 400 if lookup uses lowercased key. Quick fix: update lookup to perform case-insensitive compare fallthrough for 24 hours, and patch the str-normalization on the old pods. I'll push a hotfix to compare both UPPER(code) and LOWER(code) before declaring expired.
mike_ops: rolling rollout started. @deploy-bot kicked off canary at 1756790000.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for promo-lookup-fix (rev b3f8). Monitoring: 3m windows.
raj_engineer: hotfix merged to prod; fallback lookup added. Verified local repro now returns 200 and grants coupon. SQL used for fallback: ```SELECT * FROM promos WHERE UPPER(code)=UPPER($1) LIMIT 1;``` (temporary, replaceable by index-friendly approach)
sophie_billing: I issued a manual one-off credit of $20 to lucy@example.com while fix rolled out, TX ID: BILL-99221. Notifying the customer now.
emma_cs: replied to customer: "Hi Lucy — thanks for flagging, we've issued a one-time credit and deployed a fix. Please try again and let me know if you still see the error." :thumbsup:
raj_engineer: follow-up: we'll schedule a small DB migration to add an uppercase index and remove the fallback in 48hrs after confirming no failures. Also adding an e2e test to catch normalization mismatches.
mike_ops: monitoring shows 0.02% of promo-redeem traffic hit the fallback in the last 10m, trending down.
emma_cs: customer confirmed they were able to redeem and thanked us. closing the thread. :tada:
